decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series was a visible step into a new segment and had a page of its own, so management has committed to it publicly. Weak results can still be blamed on the pandemic years, which makes dropping it unlikely despite the uncertainty of a niche line.

The cleansing foam was announced as the newest addition to the established Sandorini series and costs little to keep. Removing it would mean admitting a misstep in a core line, so management keeps it.
